Revised 2/6.

Attempting to battle on Cloud City.  Trying out the weather vane.

== Strategy ==

My Last version of this deck i tried to play with both the weather vane and clouds.  As reviewers helped me see that just wouldn't work.  So here's my new version.

1.)  Lack of characters still may get me if i have to lose to force drains.  Hopefully i'll face a battling deck.  Losing characters should be helped by the sheer amount of ways to keep them out of the Lost Pile.  (landing them on the weater vane then pulling them back should help instead of losing them.  Cloud city celebration & Bacta Tank + 21B + FX-7 help get them back.  Incinerator lets me get the droids back.  Han's back, Leia's Back, Reflection.

How's the revision Look?
